name: Duanmu Fei VS Kobayashi Masayuki
original_name: 端木斐 VS 小林正雪
source:
The dark despair city, the fugitive drug addict, intriguing and strange urban legend. What’s the story between two characters from different detective games?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/806740/]Steam[/url]]
